subject: Animation
title: The Nine Old Men
description: A fast breakdown of The Nine Old Men for builders.

hook.text: Walt Disney relied on a core group of animators so talented he called them his Nine Old Men.

buildup.text: These artists defined Disney's visual style for forty years, from Snow White to The Jungle Book.

discovery.text: Each had a specialty. Frank Thomas excelled at emotion. Ollie Johnston mastered character acting.

twist.text: Disney borrowed the nickname from Roosevelt's insult for the Supreme Court justices.

climax.text: The Nine Old Men's teachings became the foundation of modern character animation worldwide.

punchline.text: Nine artists defined how the world draws feelings.

quiz.question: Who were Disney's Nine Old Men?
options: The studio's original board of directors
A core group of master animators who defined Disney's visual style for decades
The voice actors behind Disney's most famous characters

details.summary: Disney's Nine Old Men — the core team of master animators — developed the principles and techniques that defined Disney animation for decades. Their expertise in character animation, refined across dozens of films, became the basis for all animation education.
details.whyItMatters: Every animation school in the world teaches principles developed by the Nine Old Men. Their codification of animation technique transformed a craft taught through apprenticeship into a discipline with universal standards.
takeaways: The Nine Old Men were Disney's core creative team from the 1930s to 1970s
They developed and codified animation's foundational principles
Their techniques remain the basis of animation education worldwide

faq.question: Why did Walt Disney call them the Nine Old Men?
faq.answer: It was an affectionate reference to President Roosevelt's description of the Supreme Court. Walt used it to describe his most senior and trusted animators — the core team whose collective genius defined the Disney style across three decades.

faq.question: What is the lasting legacy of the Nine Old Men?
faq.answer: Frank Thomas and Ollie Johnston wrote The Illusion of Life, the bible of character animation. The twelve principles they codified are taught in every animation school. Their approach to personality, emotion, and physical believability remains the global standard.
